schema.notes: problems p1/p2/p3 are authored in batches per prompts/03-curriculum-graph-builder.md; standards codes pending mr-kahn verification pass

nodes.title: Integer Operations
nodes.objective: Add, subtract, multiply, and divide signed integers fluently.

contextHooks.baseball: Run differential: down 4 runs, score 7 — net is +3.
contextHooks.softball: Down 3 after the third, plate 5 in the fourth — differential is +2.
contextHooks.basketball: A −8 plus/minus that improves by 11 during your minutes lands at +3.
contextHooks.soccer: Goal differential: concede 2, score 5 across two matches — net +3.
contextHooks.football: Lose 6 yards on a sack, gain 9 on the next play — net +3 yards.
contextHooks.volleyball: Hitting stat: 5 kills minus 3 errors keeps the attack line positive.
contextHooks.neutral: A bank balance of −$4 plus a $7 deposit leaves +$3.

nodes.title: Rational Number Operations
nodes.objective: Compute with signed fractions and decimals in all four operations.

contextHooks.baseball: Batting average math: 0.275 plus a 0.025 hot streak is 0.300.
contextHooks.softball: An ERA drops 0.75 from 3.50 — quick decimal subtraction gives 2.75.
contextHooks.basketball: Free-throw rate climbs from 0.7 to 0.85 — a +0.15 change.
contextHooks.soccer: Pass completion at 0.82 dips 0.07 in the rain — now 0.75.
contextHooks.football: Yards per carry of 4.5 over half as many carries — fraction reasoning.
contextHooks.volleyball: Hitting percentage (kills−errors)/attempts is fraction arithmetic with signs.
contextHooks.neutral: Splitting a $7.50 cost three ways and adjusting by quarters.

nodes.title: Order of Operations
nodes.objective: Evaluate numeric expressions using grouping, exponents, and operation order.

contextHooks.baseball: Total bases: 3 singles + 2 doubles × 2 — multiply before adding.
contextHooks.softball: Points in a tournament: 2 wins × 3 points + 1 tie point.
contextHooks.basketball: Score: 4 threes × 3 + 6 twos × 2 + 5 free throws — order matters.
contextHooks.soccer: Table points: 5 wins × 3 + 4 draws × 1, not left to right.
contextHooks.football: Score: 3 TDs × 7 + 2 field goals × 3 demands multiplication first.
contextHooks.volleyball: Match points: 3 set wins × 25-ish rallies — grouping decides the count.

nodes.title: Exponents: Repeated Multiplication
nodes.objective: Interpret and evaluate whole-number exponents as repeated multiplication.

contextHooks.baseball: A bracket doubles each round: 2⁴ teams reach round one of regionals.
contextHooks.softball: Pool play doubling: 2⁵ teams means five rounds to a champion.
contextHooks.basketball: March-style bracket: 2⁶ = 64 teams, six wins to the title.
contextHooks.soccer: Knockout rounds halve the field: 2⁵ clubs need five rounds.
contextHooks.football: Playoff field of 2⁴ teams resolves in four elimination rounds.
contextHooks.volleyball: A 2³-team pool bracket finishes in three rounds.

nodes.title: Variables & Expressions
nodes.objective: Translate verbal phrases into algebraic expressions with variables.

contextHooks.baseball: "Two hits per game plus five so far" becomes 2g + 5.
contextHooks.softball: "Three strikeouts per inning for n innings" is 3n.
contextHooks.basketball: "Twelve points a game for g games" writes as 12g.
contextHooks.soccer: "A goal every other match" across m matches is m/2.
contextHooks.football: "Six yards a carry for c carries minus a 10-yard sack": 6c − 10.
contextHooks.volleyball: "Four kills per set for s sets" translates to 4s.
contextHooks.neutral: "Seven less than a number" is n − 7, not 7 − n.

nodes.title: Evaluating Expressions
nodes.objective: Substitute values for variables and evaluate using operation order.

contextHooks.baseball: Plug g = 12 into 2g + 5 to project 29 hits.
contextHooks.softball: Evaluate 3n for n = 7 innings: 21 strikeouts.
contextHooks.basketball: With 12g and g = 20, the season projects 240 points.
contextHooks.soccer: At m = 30, m/2 predicts 15 goals.
contextHooks.football: 6c − 10 at c = 18 carries means 98 net yards.
contextHooks.volleyball: 4s for s = 5 sets gives a 20-kill night.
contextHooks.neutral: Evaluate 3x² for x = −2: 3·(−2)² = 12.

nodes.title: Combining Like Terms
nodes.objective: Simplify expressions by combining terms with identical variable parts.

contextHooks.baseball: 5 fastballs + 3 changeups − 2 fastballs: fastballs combine, changeups don't.
contextHooks.softball: Riseballs and dropballs tally separately, like x-terms and y-terms.
contextHooks.basketball: Threes and twos add within their own kind: 4t + 3 + 2t is 6t + 3.
contextHooks.soccer: Shots on target and shots off target are unlike terms in the box score.
contextHooks.football: Rushing yards combine with rushing yards, never with passing yards.
contextHooks.volleyball: Kills add with kills; digs stay a separate term.
contextHooks.neutral: 5x + 3 − 2x simplifies to 3x + 3.

nodes.title: Distributive Property
nodes.objective: Apply a(b + c) = ab + ac to expand and factor expressions.

contextHooks.baseball: 3 innings of (2 K + 1 walk) each: distribute the 3 across both.
contextHooks.softball: 4 games of (3 hits + 1 walk) is 4·3 + 4·1.
contextHooks.basketball: 5 quarters... no — 4 quarters of (6 points + 2 assists): 4 hits every term.
contextHooks.soccer: 3 matches of (2 shots + 1 corner) each expands to 6 + 3.
contextHooks.football: 4 drives of (2 runs + 3 passes) is 8 runs and 12 passes.
contextHooks.volleyball: 5 sets of (4 kills + 2 blocks) distributes to 20 + 10.
contextHooks.neutral: 3(x + 4) = 3x + 12; the 3 multiplies every term inside.

nodes.title: Number Line & Absolute Value
nodes.objective: Locate values on a number line and interpret absolute value as distance from zero.

contextHooks.baseball: A pitch 3 inches inside or 3 outside misses by |3| either way.
contextHooks.softball: Two runners equally far from the bag in either direction: same |distance|.
contextHooks.basketball: Plus/minus of −7 and +7 are equal magnitude, opposite sign.
contextHooks.soccer: Offside by 2 yards or onside by 2 — the margin is |2|.
contextHooks.football: −5 and +5 yard plays are the same distance from the line of scrimmage.
contextHooks.volleyball: A serve 2 feet long or 2 feet short misses by the same |2|.
contextHooks.neutral: |−6| = 6 because −6 sits six units from zero.

nodes.title: Ratios, Rates & Proportional Thinking
nodes.objective: Form ratios and unit rates and reason proportionally between quantities.

contextHooks.baseball: Hits per at-bat — 27 hits in 90 ABs is a 0.300 rate.
contextHooks.softball: Strikeouts per inning: 12 K over 8 innings is 1.5 K/inning.
contextHooks.basketball: Points per game: 252 points across 14 games is 18 a night.
contextHooks.soccer: Goals per 90 minutes standardizes scorers with different minutes.
contextHooks.football: Yards per carry: 132 yards on 24 carries is 5.5.
contextHooks.volleyball: Kills per set: 44 kills in 11 sets is 4.0.
contextHooks.neutral: A unit rate is the ratio scaled to a denominator of one.

nodes.title: Percent Fundamentals
nodes.objective: Convert among fractions, decimals, and percents and find a percent of a quantity.

contextHooks.baseball: A .250 average is 25% — one hit every four at-bats.
contextHooks.softball: Stealing 18 of 20 bases is a 90% success rate.
contextHooks.basketball: Shooting 45% from the field: 45 makes per 100 attempts.
contextHooks.soccer: Completing 84 of 100 passes is an 84% completion rate.
contextHooks.football: A QB at 65% completes 65 of every 100 throws.
contextHooks.volleyball: Winning 21 of 28 service points is 75%.

nodes.title: One-Step Equations
nodes.objective: Solve equations requiring a single inverse operation.

contextHooks.baseball: Needs 12 hits, has 7: x + 7 = 12 means 5 to go.
contextHooks.softball: x + 4 = 11 strikeouts needed to reach the school record.
contextHooks.basketball: 3x = 21 — how many threes make 21 points?
contextHooks.soccer: x + 9 = 15 goals to match last season's total.
contextHooks.football: 4x = 28 — touchdowns needed for 28 points.
contextHooks.volleyball: x + 6 = 14 kills to hit tonight's target.
contextHooks.neutral: x + 7 = 12 → subtract 7 from both sides: x = 5.

nodes.title: Two-Step Equations
nodes.objective: Solve equations requiring two inverse operations in the correct order.

contextHooks.baseball: 2g + 7 = 19: starting from 7 hits at 2 per game, find g.
contextHooks.softball: 3g + 2 = 17 strikeouts — undo the +2, then the ×3.
contextHooks.basketball: 5g + 12 = 47 points: clear the 12, divide by the per-game 5.
contextHooks.soccer: 2m + 3 = 13 goal involvements across m matches.
contextHooks.football: 7t + 3 = 31: touchdowns plus a field goal reaching 31.
contextHooks.volleyball: 4s + 6 = 26 kills — constant first, coefficient second.

nodes.title: Multi-Step Equations
nodes.objective: Solve equations requiring distribution and combining like terms before isolating.

contextHooks.baseball: 2(g + 3) = 14 — expand a per-game total, then solve.
contextHooks.softball: 3(n + 1) + n = 19 mixes distribution with combining innings.
contextHooks.basketball: 2(p + 4) + 3p = 38 — simplify each side before isolating.
contextHooks.soccer: 4(m − 1) = 2m + 6 needs distribution before any inverse moves.
contextHooks.football: 3(d + 2) − d = 18 drives — expand, combine, then solve.
contextHooks.volleyball: 2(s + 3) + 4s = 30 — simplify the left side first.

nodes.title: Variables on Both Sides
nodes.objective: Collect variable terms on one side and constants on the other, then isolate.

contextHooks.baseball: 5g − 2 = 3g + 8: two hitters' pace lines meet — find the game.
contextHooks.softball: Two pitchers' strikeout paces equal: 4w + 3 = 2w + 11.
contextHooks.basketball: Your 6g + 4 catches their 8g − 6 when the sides balance.
contextHooks.soccer: Two strikers' goal projections cross: 2m + 5 = 3m + 1.
contextHooks.football: Rushing paces tie when 7c − 4 = 5c + 10.
contextHooks.volleyball: Kill totals equalize at 5s + 2 = 3s + 12.

nodes.title: Equations with Fractions & Decimals
nodes.objective: Solve equations containing rational coefficients, including clearing denominators.

contextHooks.baseball: x/3 + 0.5 = 4.5 — clear the fraction the way you'd scale innings.
contextHooks.softball: 0.4g + 1.2 = 3.6 batting-average style decimals.
contextHooks.basketball: x/4 + 2.5 = 7 — quarter-by-quarter scoring shares.
contextHooks.soccer: 0.25m + 1.5 = 4 — a goal every fourth match plus a cushion.
contextHooks.football: x/2 − 3.5 = 10.5 yardage halves and decimal lines.
contextHooks.volleyball: 0.5s + 2 = 6 — kills credited at half-rate in doubles drills.
contextHooks.neutral: x/3 + 2 = 7 → multiply through by 3: x + 6 = 21.

nodes.title: Literal Equations
nodes.objective: Solve a formula for a specified variable.

contextHooks.baseball: Rearrange AVG = H/AB to get H = AVG × AB.
contextHooks.softball: Solve ERA = 7·R/IP for R to back out runs allowed.
contextHooks.basketball: From PPG = P/G, isolate P to project a season.
contextHooks.soccer: Points = 3W + D: solve for W given a points target.
contextHooks.football: YPC = Y/C rearranges to Y = YPC × C.
contextHooks.volleyball: Hitting % = (K − E)/A — solve for K.
contextHooks.neutral: Solve P = 2l + 2w for w: w = (P − 2l)/2.

nodes.title: Solving Proportions
nodes.objective: Set up and solve proportions using equivalent ratios and cross products.

contextHooks.baseball: 27 hits in 90 ABs — at that rate, how many in 150 ABs?
contextHooks.softball: 12 K in 8 innings: project strikeouts over a 21-inning weekend.
contextHooks.basketball: At 18 points per 32 minutes, what does 40 minutes yield?
contextHooks.soccer: 7 goals in 900 minutes scales to how many per full season?
contextHooks.football: 5.5 yards per carry over 24 carries projects to 30 carries how?
contextHooks.volleyball: 44 kills in 11 sets — keep the rate over a 15-set week.
contextHooks.neutral: x/12 = 3/4 → x = 9 by equivalent ratios.

nodes.title: Percent Applications
nodes.objective: Solve percent-change, discount, and percent-of-total problems with equations.

contextHooks.baseball: An average jumping .250 → .300 is a 20% improvement, not 5%.
contextHooks.softball: Raising stolen-base success from 75% to 90% — find the percent change.
contextHooks.basketball: FG% up from 40 to 46 is a 15% relative gain.
contextHooks.soccer: Possession rising 50% → 58% — compute the change off the right base.
contextHooks.football: Completion percentage improving 60 → 66 is a 10% lift.
contextHooks.volleyball: Serve-receive rating up 12% from a 2.0 base lands at 2.24.
contextHooks.neutral: A $40 item marked down 25% costs $30.

nodes.title: One-Step Inequalities
nodes.objective: Solve and graph single-operation inequalities on a number line.

contextHooks.baseball: Need more than 12 hits to lead the team: x + 7 > 12.
contextHooks.softball: At most 3 walks allowed: w ≤ 3 shades left on the line.
contextHooks.basketball: 3t ≥ 21 — at least how many threes for 21+ points?
contextHooks.soccer: Yellow cards under the suspension line: c < 5.
contextHooks.football: x + 6 ≥ 10 yards needed for the first down.
contextHooks.volleyball: Service errors capped: e ≤ 2 per set.
contextHooks.neutral: x + 7 > 12 → x > 5; open circle, shade right.

nodes.title: Multi-Step Inequalities
nodes.objective: Solve multi-step inequalities, reversing the symbol when multiplying or dividing by a negative.

contextHooks.baseball: −2g + 20 < 12: losing 2 mph of velocity per inning past a limit.
contextHooks.softball: 15 − 3w > 6 pitches of margin — dividing by −3 flips the sign.
contextHooks.basketball: 40 − 4q ≤ 24 minutes remaining across quarters.
contextHooks.soccer: −5m + 45 ≥ 20 — fitness minutes burning down each match.
contextHooks.football: 60 − 7d < 25 seconds of clock per drive.
contextHooks.volleyball: 25 − 2r ≤ 13 rally points left — the negative flips it.
contextHooks.neutral: −2x < 10 → x > −5; dividing by a negative reverses the inequality.

nodes.title: Compound Inequalities
nodes.objective: Solve and graph AND/OR compound inequalities and interpret their solution sets.

contextHooks.baseball: A strike zone is an AND: 18 ≤ height ≤ 42 inches.
contextHooks.softball: Legal pitch speed window: 55 ≤ s ≤ 65 for this drill.
contextHooks.basketball: Foul trouble OR statement: sit if fouls ≥ 4 or minutes ≥ 36.
contextHooks.soccer: Squad eligibility: 13 ≤ age ≤ 14 — both must hold.
contextHooks.football: A catchable window: 5 < yards < 15 downfield.
contextHooks.volleyball: Set won by 2 within bounds: 25 ≤ p and p − o ≥ 2.
contextHooks.neutral: −3 < x ≤ 4 graphs as a segment: open at −3, closed at 4.

nodes.title: Absolute Value Equations
nodes.objective: Solve equations of the form |ax + b| = c by splitting into two cases.

contextHooks.baseball: |x − 90| = 3: pitch speeds 3 mph either side of 90.
contextHooks.softball: |t − 60| = 2 — release speeds two off the 60 target.
contextHooks.basketball: |p − 20| = 4: nights 4 points above or below the average.
contextHooks.soccer: |m − 45| = 5 minutes around halftime, both directions.
contextHooks.football: |y − 10| = 2: gains landing 2 yards either side of the sticks.
contextHooks.volleyball: |s − 50| = 5 mph around the serve-speed target.
contextHooks.neutral: |x − 3| = 7 splits into x − 3 = 7 or x − 3 = −7.

nodes.title: Modeling with Linear Equations
nodes.objective: Translate real situations into linear equations and interpret solutions in context.

contextHooks.baseball: Build the equation for when two hitters' season totals tie.
contextHooks.softball: Model tournament costs: entry fee plus per-game umpire fees.
contextHooks.basketball: Write the equation for reaching 1,000 career points this season.
contextHooks.soccer: Model points needed from remaining matches to reach 40.
contextHooks.football: Set up yards-per-game needed to break the school record.
contextHooks.volleyball: Model kills needed per set to finish the season at 4.0.
contextHooks.neutral: Define the variable, write the equation, solve, answer in context.

nodes.title: The Coordinate Plane
nodes.objective: Plot and read ordered pairs across all four quadrants.

contextHooks.baseball: A spray chart: x is pull-side to oppo, y is depth.
contextHooks.softball: Plot hit locations: left-right of second base versus distance.
contextHooks.basketball: A shot chart maps every attempt as (court-x, court-y).
contextHooks.soccer: Heat maps place touches by field position coordinates.
contextHooks.football: Target charts: yards downfield (y) versus hash position (x).
contextHooks.volleyball: Attack charts mark where each kill lands in the court grid.
contextHooks.neutral: (3, 2) means 3 right, 2 up from the origin.

nodes.title: Relations & Functions
nodes.objective: Identify functions as relations assigning exactly one output to each input.

contextHooks.baseball: Each game number maps to exactly one final score — a function.
contextHooks.softball: Jersey number → player is a function; position → player isn't.
contextHooks.basketball: Each minute mark has one score margin; margins repeat, minutes don't.
contextHooks.soccer: Match day → result is a function of the schedule.
contextHooks.football: Each play number produces exactly one yardage outcome.
contextHooks.volleyball: Each rally has one winner — rally number maps to one team.
contextHooks.neutral: A function assigns each input exactly one output.

nodes.title: Function Notation
nodes.objective: Read, write, and evaluate functions using f(x) notation.

contextHooks.baseball: h(g) = total hits after g games; evaluate h(12).
contextHooks.softball: k(i) gives strikeouts through inning i.
contextHooks.basketball: p(g) = 12g models points; p(20) projects the season.
contextHooks.soccer: g(m) returns goals through match m.
contextHooks.football: y(c) = 6c − 10 nets yardage for c carries; find y(18).
contextHooks.volleyball: k(s) = 4s counts kills through set s.
contextHooks.neutral: If f(x) = 3x + 1, then f(4) = 13 — f(4) is not f times 4.

nodes.title: Domain & Range
nodes.objective: Determine reasonable domains and ranges from graphs, tables, and contexts.

contextHooks.baseball: Innings 1–9 is the domain; runs scored is the range.
contextHooks.softball: Pitch count can't be negative — context restricts the domain.
contextHooks.basketball: Minutes played live in [0, 48]; points form the range.
contextHooks.soccer: Match minutes 0–90 bound the domain of a fitness curve.
contextHooks.football: Down number is a domain of {1, 2, 3, 4} — discrete and finite.
contextHooks.volleyball: Set scores cap the range; rallies index the domain.
contextHooks.neutral: Domain: allowed inputs. Range: resulting outputs.

nodes.title: Slope as Rate of Change
nodes.objective: Interpret slope as a constant rate: change in output per unit input.

contextHooks.baseball: 6 hits by game 4, 18 by game 10 — the line climbs 2 per game.
contextHooks.softball: Strikeouts rising 3 per game traces a steady slope.
contextHooks.basketball: A scorer adding 18 a night has a season line of slope 18.
contextHooks.soccer: Two points per match on average is the table-climb rate.
contextHooks.football: Cumulative yards growing 110 per game — that's the slope.
contextHooks.volleyball: Kills accumulating 4 per set set the line's steepness.
contextHooks.neutral: Slope = rise/run = Δy/Δx, a constant rate.

nodes.title: Slope from Two Points
nodes.objective: Compute slope from coordinate pairs using m = (y₂ − y₁)/(x₂ − x₁).

contextHooks.baseball: Box scores at (4, 6) and (10, 18) hits give m = 2.
contextHooks.softball: K totals at games 2 and 7 — two snapshots, one rate.
contextHooks.basketball: (5, 90) and (10, 180) points: slope 18 per game.
contextHooks.soccer: (8, 12) and (14, 24) table points yield slope 2.
contextHooks.football: (3, 330) and (6, 660) yards — the formula gives 110.
contextHooks.volleyball: (4, 16) and (9, 36) kills: m = 4 per set.

nodes.title: Patterns, Tables & Graphs
nodes.objective: Move between tables, rules, and graphs of linear patterns.

contextHooks.baseball: A hits-by-game table becomes a rule, then a line.
contextHooks.softball: Inning-by-inning K table → expression → graph.
contextHooks.basketball: Quarter scores tabled, ruled, and graphed as one pattern.
contextHooks.soccer: Matchday points table converts to a climbing line.
contextHooks.football: Drive-by-drive yardage table reveals the per-drive rule.
contextHooks.volleyball: Set-by-set kill table maps to a straight-line trend.
contextHooks.neutral: Same linear relationship, three representations.

nodes.title: Slope-Intercept Form
nodes.objective: Identify slope and y-intercept directly from y = mx + b and interpret both.

contextHooks.baseball: y = 2x + 7: 7 hits banked, 2 added per game.
contextHooks.softball: Starting 3 K with 3 more per inning: y = 3x + 3.
contextHooks.basketball: y = 18x + 0 — a fresh season at 18 a night.
contextHooks.soccer: y = 2x + 4: four points carried in, two per match.
contextHooks.football: y = 110x + 0 cumulative yards; b is the starting total.
contextHooks.volleyball: y = 4x + 6 — six kills already, four each new set.
contextHooks.neutral: In y = mx + b, m is rate, b is the starting value.

nodes.title: Graphing Linear Equations
nodes.objective: Graph a line from slope-intercept form using the intercept and rise/run.

contextHooks.baseball: Plot the 7-hit start, climb 2-per-game, draw the pace line.
contextHooks.softball: Graph the strikeout pace and read the record-breaking game.
contextHooks.basketball: Draw the 18-a-night line and project game 30.
contextHooks.soccer: The points line shows exactly when 40 points arrives.
contextHooks.football: Graph cumulative yards to see the 1,500 crossing.
contextHooks.volleyball: Plot kill pace; the line predicts the milestone set.
contextHooks.neutral: Start at (0, b), step rise over run, connect.

nodes.title: x- and y-Intercepts
nodes.objective: Find and interpret intercepts from equations and graphs.

contextHooks.baseball: The y-intercept is hits before game one; x-intercept, when a deficit clears.
contextHooks.softball: Where the run-differential line crosses zero is the comeback game.
contextHooks.basketball: A point-margin line's x-intercept is the tie moment.
contextHooks.soccer: Goal differential hitting zero marks level on aggregate.
contextHooks.football: x-intercept: the drive where negative field position is erased.
contextHooks.volleyball: A deficit line crossing zero is when the set draws even.
contextHooks.neutral: x-intercept: set y = 0. y-intercept: set x = 0.

nodes.title: Point-Slope Form
nodes.objective: Write linear equations using y − y₁ = m(x − x₁) from a point and slope.

contextHooks.baseball: Known: 12 hits at game 5, pace 2 — write y − 12 = 2(x − 5).
contextHooks.softball: At inning 4 with 9 K, rate 3: anchor the line at that point.
contextHooks.basketball: Mid-season snapshot plus scoring rate writes the equation.
contextHooks.soccer: From (10 matches, 22 points) at 2 per match, build the line.
contextHooks.football: Anchor at (4 games, 440 yards) with slope 110.
contextHooks.volleyball: Through (6 sets, 25 kills) at 4 per set — point-slope it.
contextHooks.neutral: Slope 2 through (1, 5): y − 5 = 2(x − 1).

nodes.title: Standard Form
nodes.objective: Convert between standard form Ax + By = C and other linear forms; graph via intercepts.

contextHooks.baseball: 2x + 3y = 24: combinations of doubles and triples for 24 bases... total bases as a budget line.
contextHooks.softball: Singles and doubles totaling 18 bases: x + 2y = 18.
contextHooks.basketball: 2x + 3y = 30 — twos and threes that combine for 30 points.
contextHooks.soccer: 3w + 1d = 21: win/draw combinations reaching 21 points.
contextHooks.football: 7t + 3f = 31 — TD and field-goal mixes scoring 31.
contextHooks.volleyball: Kills and aces budgeting to a points target: x + y = 25.
contextHooks.neutral: Ax + By = C graphs fastest from its two intercepts.

nodes.title: Writing Linear Equations
nodes.objective: Construct linear equations from a slope and point, two points, or a context.

contextHooks.baseball: Two box-score snapshots — write the full season pace equation.
contextHooks.softball: Rate plus one game's total: solve for b, state the model.
contextHooks.basketball: From (5, 90) and (12, 216), write y = 18x + 0... derive both m and b.
contextHooks.soccer: Two table checkpoints define the club's points equation.
contextHooks.football: Build the yardage model from weeks 3 and 7 totals.
contextHooks.volleyball: Two set-totals determine the kill-pace equation exactly.
contextHooks.neutral: Find m, substitute a point, solve for b, write y = mx + b.

nodes.title: Parallel & Perpendicular Lines
nodes.objective: Use slope relationships to identify and write parallel and perpendicular lines.

contextHooks.baseball: Two hitters on identical paces: parallel lines, never crossing.
contextHooks.softball: Equal-rate pitchers trace parallel strikeout lines.
contextHooks.basketball: Same scoring rate, different starts — parallel forever.
contextHooks.soccer: A pressing run perpendicular to the passing lane has slope −1/m.
contextHooks.football: A crossing route cuts the seam route at a negative-reciprocal slope.
contextHooks.volleyball: A line shot versus the cross-court angle: perpendicular paths.
contextHooks.neutral: Parallel: equal slopes. Perpendicular: slopes multiply to −1.

nodes.title: Graphing Linear Inequalities
nodes.objective: Graph two-variable linear inequalities with correct boundary and shading.

contextHooks.baseball: Pitch-count safety region: combinations under the workload line.
contextHooks.softball: Innings-and-pitches limits shade a legal-use region.
contextHooks.basketball: Minutes restrictions: the allowed (games, minutes) half-plane.
contextHooks.soccer: Training-load zone: shaded combinations below the red line.
contextHooks.football: Practice-rep limits define a feasible shaded region.
contextHooks.volleyball: Jump-load management shades safe (sets, attempts) pairs.
contextHooks.neutral: y > 2x + 1: dashed boundary, shade where the test point works.

nodes.title: Scatter Plots & Trend Lines
nodes.objective: Construct scatter plots, describe association, and fit informal trend lines.

contextHooks.baseball: Exit velocity vs. distance: plot it, eyeball the trend.
contextHooks.softball: Practice swings vs. average — scattered, but trending up.
contextHooks.basketball: Minutes vs. points scatters with a positive association.
contextHooks.soccer: Sprints vs. chances created — plot and fit a line.
contextHooks.football: Carries vs. yards: the trend line estimates yards per carry.
contextHooks.volleyball: Approach jumps vs. kills across matches, fitted informally.
contextHooks.neutral: A trend line summarizes the pattern, not every point.

nodes.title: Arithmetic Sequences
nodes.objective: Identify common differences and write explicit rules for arithmetic sequences.

contextHooks.baseball: Card collection growing by 6 a week: aₙ = 6n + start.
contextHooks.softball: Adding 2 mph of velocity per month follows a common difference.
contextHooks.basketball: Free-throw streaks rising 5 per week form a sequence.
contextHooks.soccer: Season tickets adding 3 matches a year: arithmetic growth.
contextHooks.football: Bench press up 5 pounds weekly — write the nth-week rule.
contextHooks.volleyball: Serve speed gains of 1 mph per week sequence cleanly.
contextHooks.neutral: aₙ = a₁ + (n − 1)d — a line sampled at whole numbers.

nodes.title: Direct Variation
nodes.objective: Recognize y = kx relationships and find constants of proportionality.

contextHooks.baseball: Total bases vary directly with hits when every hit's a single.
contextHooks.softball: Pitches thrown varies directly with batters faced at a steady rate.
contextHooks.basketball: Points from threes: p = 3t, straight through the origin.
contextHooks.soccer: Distance covered varies directly with minutes at constant pace.
contextHooks.football: Yards = 5.5 × carries when the rate never wavers.
contextHooks.volleyball: Points from aces: p = 1a — direct, origin-anchored.
contextHooks.neutral: y = kx: doubles when x doubles, graph passes through (0, 0).

nodes.title: Systems by Graphing
nodes.objective: Solve a system of linear equations as the intersection point of two lines.

contextHooks.baseball: Two hitters' pace lines cross at the game their totals tie.
contextHooks.softball: Strikeout paces intersect — read the meeting point.
contextHooks.basketball: Your scoring line catches the leader's where they cross.
contextHooks.soccer: Two clubs' points lines intersect at the table-flip match.
contextHooks.football: Rushing pace lines cross at the week the race ties.
contextHooks.volleyball: Kill paces meet at one set — the intersection.
contextHooks.neutral: The solution is the one point both lines share.

nodes.title: Systems by Substitution
nodes.objective: Solve systems algebraically by substituting one expression into the other equation.

contextHooks.baseball: y = 2x doubles-to-singles ratio inside x + y = 9 hits.
contextHooks.softball: Express walks via strikeouts, substitute into the total.
contextHooks.basketball: y = 2x threes-to-twos relation inside the points total.
contextHooks.soccer: Assists defined by goals, substituted into involvements.
contextHooks.football: Pass yards as a function of rush yards inside total offense.
contextHooks.volleyball: Blocks expressed through kills inside the points equation.
contextHooks.neutral: Replace a variable with its equal expression; solve one unknown.

nodes.title: Systems by Elimination
nodes.objective: Solve systems by adding or subtracting scaled equations to eliminate a variable.

contextHooks.baseball: Ticket math: 2 adult + 3 youth = $24 vs 2 adult + 1 youth = $16.
contextHooks.softball: Equipment orders with matching bat coefficients cancel cleanly.
contextHooks.basketball: Two box scores with equal twos columns — subtract to isolate threes.
contextHooks.soccer: Two fixture bundles share a coefficient; eliminate and solve.
contextHooks.football: Concession combos: align coefficients, subtract, solve.
contextHooks.volleyball: Two fundraiser orders eliminate the t-shirt variable.
contextHooks.neutral: Scale, then add/subtract so one variable cancels.

nodes.title: Systems: Special Cases
nodes.objective: Recognize systems with no solution or infinitely many solutions.

contextHooks.baseball: Identical paces from different starts never tie — no solution.
contextHooks.softball: Same line written two ways: infinitely many shared points.
contextHooks.basketball: Parallel scoring lines mean the gap never closes.
contextHooks.soccer: Equivalent points equations describe one identical line.
contextHooks.football: Same rate, different head start: the chase never ends.
contextHooks.volleyball: Two descriptions of one kill pace — every point works.
contextHooks.neutral: 0 = 5 → no solution. 0 = 0 → infinitely many.

nodes.title: Systems Word Problems
nodes.objective: Model two-constraint situations as systems, solve, and interpret in context.

contextHooks.baseball: Tickets and concessions: two totals, two unknowns, one system.
contextHooks.softball: Bats and gloves bought under a count and a budget constraint.
contextHooks.basketball: Twos and threes from total makes and total points.
contextHooks.soccer: Wins and draws recovered from matches played and points earned.
contextHooks.football: TDs and field goals from scores and scoring plays.
contextHooks.volleyball: Kills and aces from total points and total attempts.
contextHooks.neutral: Two facts about two unknowns — define both, build both equations.

nodes.title: Systems of Inequalities
nodes.objective: Graph systems of linear inequalities and identify the feasible region.

contextHooks.baseball: Roster limits and budget caps overlap into a feasible region.
contextHooks.softball: Pitch counts AND innings limits shade one legal zone.
contextHooks.basketball: Minutes and games restrictions intersect into the safe region.
contextHooks.soccer: Training load plus match minutes bound the green zone.
contextHooks.football: Practice reps and contact limits overlap legally.
contextHooks.volleyball: Jump counts and set limits define the overlap to stay in.
contextHooks.neutral: The feasible region satisfies every inequality at once.

nodes.title: Product & Power Rules
nodes.objective: Apply product and power rules for integer exponents.

contextHooks.baseball: Doubling drills: 2³ reps × 2² circuits = 2⁵ total.
contextHooks.softball: Bracket math compounds: (2²)³ rounds of pool play.
contextHooks.basketball: Doubling scrimmage pairs across rounds multiplies powers.
contextHooks.soccer: Passing-drill grids of 3² players run 3³ touches each round.
contextHooks.football: Playbook trees: 2⁴ formations × 2² motions = 2⁶ looks.
contextHooks.volleyball: Rotation combinations stack as powers of 6... powers multiply when raised.
contextHooks.neutral: xᵃ · xᵇ = xᵃ⁺ᵇ and (xᵃ)ᵇ = xᵃᵇ.

nodes.title: Quotient, Zero & Negative Exponents
nodes.objective: Simplify expressions with quotient, zero, and negative exponents.

contextHooks.baseball: Halving a stat each season: 2⁻¹, 2⁻², shrinking but positive.
contextHooks.softball: Pitch-speed decay framed as negative-exponent scaling.
contextHooks.basketball: A streak halving nightly is 2⁻ⁿ of the original — never negative.
contextHooks.soccer: Possession share halving by round: positive fractions, negative exponents.
contextHooks.football: x⁰ = 1: any rate over itself is one, even yards per yard.
contextHooks.volleyball: Error rate halving each week: (1/2)ⁿ in exponent form.
contextHooks.neutral: x⁻ⁿ = 1/xⁿ and x⁰ = 1 (x ≠ 0).

nodes.title: Scientific Notation
nodes.objective: Express and compute with very large and small numbers in scientific notation.

contextHooks.baseball: MLB attendance near 7 × 10⁷ fans a season.
contextHooks.softball: A 6.0 × 10⁻¹ second pitch flight time, written compactly.
contextHooks.basketball: League revenue around 1 × 10¹⁰ dollars.
contextHooks.soccer: World Cup viewership: roughly 1.5 × 10⁹ people.
contextHooks.football: Stadium-weekend economics measured in 10⁸ dollars.
contextHooks.volleyball: Ball contact time near 1 × 10⁻² seconds.
contextHooks.neutral: a × 10ⁿ with 1 ≤ a < 10 — the exponent carries the scale.

nodes.title: Exponential Functions: Growth & Decay
nodes.objective: Contrast exponential and linear growth and model with y = a·bˣ.

contextHooks.baseball: A viral highlight doubling views daily outruns any linear pace.
contextHooks.softball: Bracket entrants halving each round is decay with b = 1/2.
contextHooks.basketball: Compound improvement of 5% per month is y = a(1.05)ˣ.
contextHooks.soccer: Followers doubling monthly vs. adding 100 — curves beat lines.
contextHooks.football: Recruiting buzz doubling weekly is exponential, not slope.
contextHooks.volleyball: Drill difficulty scaling 1.1× per week compounds.
contextHooks.neutral: Linear adds the same amount; exponential multiplies by the same factor.

nodes.title: Polynomial Vocabulary & Structure
nodes.objective: Classify polynomials by degree and term count; identify leading coefficients.

contextHooks.baseball: A height-vs-time fly ball is degree 2 — that's why it arcs.
contextHooks.softball: Pop-up flight: quadratic, two real landings... degree sets the shape.
contextHooks.basketball: A jumper's arc is a degree-2 polynomial in time.
contextHooks.soccer: A chipped pass traces a quadratic; a rolled pass is linear.
contextHooks.football: Punt hang time lives in a degree-2 height polynomial.
contextHooks.volleyball: A serve's flight path: classify it by its degree.
contextHooks.neutral: 3x² − 5x + 2: trinomial, degree 2, leading coefficient 3.

nodes.title: Adding & Subtracting Polynomials
nodes.objective: Add and subtract polynomials by combining like terms, distributing negatives correctly.

contextHooks.baseball: Combine two players' (at-bats, hits, walks) stat polynomials.
contextHooks.softball: Subtract last year's stat polynomial from this year's — watch signs.
contextHooks.basketball: Merge two box-score polynomials term by matching term.
contextHooks.soccer: Add home and away stat expressions; degrees stay separate.
contextHooks.football: Offense minus defense expression: distribute the minus fully.
contextHooks.volleyball: Combine set-by-set stat polynomials, like terms only.

nodes.title: Multiplying Monomials & Polynomials
nodes.objective: Multiply a monomial by a polynomial using distribution and exponent rules.

contextHooks.baseball: Scale a per-game stat polynomial by 3x games.
contextHooks.softball: 2x innings × (3x + 1) pitches per inning — distribute and add exponents.
contextHooks.basketball: 4x quarters × (2x + 5) possessions: every term gets multiplied.
contextHooks.soccer: 3x matches × (x + 2) chances each expands by distribution.
contextHooks.football: 5x drives × (2x + 3) plays per drive — area model it.
contextHooks.volleyball: 2x sets × (4x + 1) rallies: monomial times binomial.

nodes.title: Multiplying Binomials
nodes.objective: Multiply binomials using the area model and distribution (four partial products).

contextHooks.baseball: An (x + 3) by (x + 5) outfield section: four areas, one product.
contextHooks.softball: Expanding the practice field (x + 2)(x + 4) — count all four regions.
contextHooks.basketball: A court extension (x + 4)(x + 6): the middle terms are real area.
contextHooks.soccer: Pitch resized to (x + 5)(x + 8) — partial products fill the grid.
contextHooks.football: Field section (x + 10)(x + 3): the area model shows every piece.
contextHooks.volleyball: Court plus buffer: (x + 1)(x + 9) expands to four terms first.
contextHooks.neutral: (x + 3)(x + 5) = x² + 8x + 15 — four products, then combine.

nodes.title: Special Products
nodes.objective: Expand perfect-square binomials and conjugate pairs using their patterns.

contextHooks.baseball: A square infield (x + 3)² is x² + 6x + 9 — never just x² + 9.
contextHooks.softball: (x + 2)² practice square: the middle 2·2x is real grass.
contextHooks.basketball: (x + 5)(x − 5) court trim: middles cancel, x² − 25 remains.
contextHooks.soccer: Square training grid (x + 4)²: three terms, always.
contextHooks.football: (x + 7)(x − 7) field strips collapse to a difference of squares.
contextHooks.volleyball: (x + 3)(x − 3) court margins: conjugates kill the middle.
contextHooks.neutral: (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²; (a + b)(a − b) = a² − b².

nodes.title: Factoring with GCF
nodes.objective: Factor polynomials by extracting the greatest common factor.

contextHooks.baseball: 6x² + 9x reps: pull the common 3x out of every drill block.
contextHooks.softball: Shared warm-up factor across all stations comes out front.
contextHooks.basketball: 12x² + 8x possessions share a 4x — factor it cleanly.
contextHooks.soccer: Common training block 5x divides both 10x² and 15x.
contextHooks.football: Every package shares 2x plays: factor before anything else.
contextHooks.volleyball: 4x² + 6x contacts share 2x across both terms.
contextHooks.neutral: 6x² + 9x = 3x(2x + 3) — undistribute the GCF.

nodes.title: Factoring Trinomials (a = 1)
nodes.objective: Factor x² + bx + c by finding integers with the right sum and product.

contextHooks.baseball: Reverse the outfield expansion: x² + 8x + 15 back to (x+3)(x+5).
contextHooks.softball: Un-expand the practice field: which dimensions multiply back?
contextHooks.basketball: x² + 10x + 24 court area refactors into its side lengths.
contextHooks.soccer: Recover pitch dimensions from the expanded area trinomial.
contextHooks.football: x² + 13x + 30 of field area: find the two added strips.
contextHooks.volleyball: Reverse-engineer the court-plus-buffer dimensions.
contextHooks.neutral: x² + 8x + 15: numbers multiplying to 15, adding to 8 → (x+3)(x+5).

nodes.title: Factoring Trinomials (a ≠ 1)
nodes.objective: Factor ax² + bx + c using grouping or systematic trial with the ac method.

contextHooks.baseball: 2x² + 11x + 12 of bleacher sections factors by the ac method.
contextHooks.softball: 3x² + 10x + 8 — split the middle using ac = 24.
contextHooks.basketball: 2x² + 7x + 6 court zones group into two binomials.
contextHooks.soccer: 6x² + 13x + 6 pitch panels: ac grouping finds the split.
contextHooks.football: 4x² + 12x + 9 — check whether it's a perfect-square section.
contextHooks.volleyball: 2x² + 9x + 4 factors once the middle term splits right.
contextHooks.neutral: 2x² + 11x + 12 = (2x + 3)(x + 4) via the ac method.

nodes.title: Factoring Special Products
nodes.objective: Factor differences of squares and perfect-square trinomials by pattern.

contextHooks.baseball: x² − 49 field strips factor straight to (x+7)(x−7).
contextHooks.softball: x² − 25 splits into conjugates on sight.
contextHooks.basketball: x² + 12x + 36 is (x + 6)² — recognize, don't grind.
contextHooks.soccer: 4x² − 81: difference of squares with a twist on a.
contextHooks.football: 9x² + 30x + 25 — a perfect square hiding in plain sight.
contextHooks.volleyball: x² − 100 of court margin factors instantly by pattern.
contextHooks.neutral: a² − b² = (a+b)(a−b); a² + 2ab + b² = (a+b)².

nodes.title: Simplifying Radicals
nodes.objective: Simplify square roots by extracting perfect-square factors.

contextHooks.baseball: The 90-foot diagonal home-to-second is 90√2 — radicals are distances.
contextHooks.softball: A 60-foot diamond's diagonal: 60√2 feet, exactly.
contextHooks.basketball: Diagonal of a 50-by-50 zone is 50√2 — simplify, don't decimal.
contextHooks.soccer: Corner-to-corner of a square box: side × √2.
contextHooks.football: A 30-yard square section's diagonal is 30√2 yards.
contextHooks.volleyball: Court diagonal math leaves a √2 standing — keep it exact.

nodes.title: Quadratic Functions & Parabolas
nodes.objective: Graph quadratics and identify vertex, axis of symmetry, intercepts, and direction.

contextHooks.baseball: A fly ball's height-time graph: the vertex is peak height.
contextHooks.softball: A pop-up's parabola — symmetry says up-time equals down-time.
contextHooks.basketball: A free throw's arc peaks at the vertex, drops symmetrically.
contextHooks.soccer: A chipped shot traces a parabola over the keeper.
contextHooks.football: Punt hang time: the vertex is apex, the x-intercept is the catch.
contextHooks.volleyball: A perfect set peaks above the net — read its vertex.
contextHooks.neutral: y = ax² + bx + c: vertex at x = −b/(2a), symmetric arms.

nodes.title: Solving by Factoring
nodes.objective: Solve quadratic equations using the zero-product property.

contextHooks.baseball: Height h = −16t² + 48t hits zero when the ball lands — factor for t.
contextHooks.softball: Set the pop-up height to zero; the factors are catch times.
contextHooks.basketball: Shot height zero at release and rim-fall: two factor roots.
contextHooks.soccer: The chip lands when each factor of h(t) = 0 says so.
contextHooks.football: Punt: −16t² + 64t = 0 factors to t = 0 and t = 4.
contextHooks.volleyball: Serve height zero at contact and at the floor — both roots matter.
contextHooks.neutral: If (x − 3)(x + 2) = 0 then x = 3 or x = −2; never divide by x.

nodes.title: Solving by Square Roots
nodes.objective: Solve ax² = c and (x − h)² = k by extracting roots, keeping both solutions.

contextHooks.baseball: x² = 8100: the base path squared back to ±90 — context keeps +90.
contextHooks.softball: Square drill area 3600 ft² has side √3600 = 60.
contextHooks.basketball: (x − 2)² = 25 free-throw drill: x is 7 or −3.
contextHooks.soccer: A square zone of 144 m² has 12 m sides — root both ways, keep sense.
contextHooks.football: x² = 900 yards squared: ±30, the field says +30.
contextHooks.volleyball: (x − 1)² = 16: two algebraic answers, one physical one.
contextHooks.neutral: x² = 49 → x = ±7. Both roots, always, then filter by context.

nodes.title: Completing the Square
nodes.objective: Rewrite quadratics in vertex form by completing the square and solve from it.

contextHooks.baseball: Rebuild the fly-ball equation around its peak — vertex form by construction.
contextHooks.softball: Force x² + 6x into a perfect square: add 9, balance 9.
contextHooks.basketball: Re-center the arc equation on its apex by completing the square.
contextHooks.soccer: The chip's equation, rewritten so the vertex reads directly.
contextHooks.football: Hang-time quadratic into (t − h)² form — apex on display.
contextHooks.volleyball: Complete the square to expose the set's peak height.

nodes.title: The Quadratic Formula
nodes.objective: Solve any quadratic with x = (−b ± √(b² − 4ac)) / (2a).

contextHooks.baseball: When is the fly ball at exactly 20 feet? The formula answers both times.
contextHooks.softball: Pop-up at fence height: plug a, b, c, get both crossing times.
contextHooks.basketball: Arc at rim height twice — the ± is the up and the down.
contextHooks.soccer: The chip at crossbar height: formula yields both instants.
contextHooks.football: Punt at 30 feet going up and coming down: two roots, one formula.
contextHooks.volleyball: Set at net height twice per flight — quadratic formula finds both.
contextHooks.neutral: x = (−b ± √(b²−4ac))/(2a) solves every quadratic.

nodes.title: The Discriminant
nodes.objective: Use b² − 4ac to determine the number and type of solutions.

contextHooks.baseball: Does the fly ball ever reach 120 feet? The discriminant says before you solve.
contextHooks.softball: Can the pop-up clear that height at all — check b² − 4ac first.
contextHooks.basketball: Will the arc reach 13 feet? Negative discriminant: never.
contextHooks.soccer: Does the chip reach crossbar height once, twice, or never?
contextHooks.football: Punt vs. the upper deck: the discriminant predicts contact.
contextHooks.volleyball: Can this set peak at 12 feet? Sign of b² − 4ac decides.
contextHooks.neutral: Positive: two real roots. Zero: one. Negative: none.

nodes.title: Modeling with Quadratics
nodes.objective: Build and interpret quadratic models for projectile, area, and optimization contexts.

contextHooks.baseball: Model the throw from deep right: peak, hang time, landing — all from one equation.
contextHooks.softball: Build h(t) for the pop-up, then answer the catchability question.
contextHooks.basketball: Optimal arc: model the shot, read the vertex, hit the rim line.
contextHooks.soccer: Model the chip and verify it clears the keeper at x = 4.
contextHooks.football: Maximize area of a fenced practice zone — vertex of the area model.
contextHooks.volleyball: Model the serve and decide if it clears net and lands in.
contextHooks.neutral: Define the function, identify what the vertex and roots mean, answer in context.

nodes.title: Measures of Center & Spread
nodes.objective: Compute and interpret mean, median, mode, range, and interquartile range.

contextHooks.baseball: Season batting averages: one 4-for-4 night drags the mean, not the median.
contextHooks.softball: Pitch-speed median vs. mean reveals the outlier bullpen session.
contextHooks.basketball: Points per game: median resists the 40-point outburst.
contextHooks.soccer: Goals per match across a squad — spread tells the depth story.
contextHooks.football: Yards per carry: one 80-yard run inflates the mean.
contextHooks.volleyball: Kills per set centered and spread across the rotation.
contextHooks.neutral: Mean averages everything; median resists outliers.

nodes.title: Data Displays
nodes.objective: Construct and interpret histograms, box plots, and dot plots.

contextHooks.baseball: Exit velocities binned into a histogram show the swing profile.
contextHooks.softball: A box plot of pitch counts exposes the workload quartiles.
contextHooks.basketball: Shot distances histogrammed reveal the offense's identity.
contextHooks.soccer: Sprint distances box-plotted compare midfield workloads.
contextHooks.football: Play-gain dot plots separate the boom from the bust.
contextHooks.volleyball: Serve speeds histogrammed show the team's velocity bands.
contextHooks.neutral: Histograms bin values; box plots summarize five numbers.

nodes.title: Two-Way Tables
nodes.objective: Organize categorical data in two-way tables and compute relative frequencies.

contextHooks.baseball: Hits vs. pitch type in a two-way table: what % of fastballs became hits?
contextHooks.softball: Steal attempts by count, success by row — read the right percent.
contextHooks.basketball: Makes vs. shot zone tabled: corner-three conversion rate.
contextHooks.soccer: Shots by half vs. on-target — row percents tell the story.
contextHooks.football: Run/pass vs. down in a table: third-down pass frequency.
contextHooks.volleyball: Serve type vs. ace/error cross-tabbed by rotation.
contextHooks.neutral: Joint, marginal, and conditional frequencies answer different questions.

nodes.title: Interpreting Lines of Best Fit
nodes.objective: Interpret slope and intercept of fitted lines in context and judge fit quality.

contextHooks.baseball: The fit line's slope: extra exit-velo mph per pound of bat speed work.
contextHooks.softball: Practice hours vs. average — interpret the slope as gain per hour.
contextHooks.basketball: Minutes vs. points fit: the slope is points per extra minute.
contextHooks.soccer: Sprints vs. chances: slope quantifies the pressing payoff.
contextHooks.football: Carries vs. yards fit — the intercept may mean nothing real.
contextHooks.volleyball: Jump training vs. kill rate: read the slope, doubt the extrapolation.
contextHooks.neutral: Slope: predicted change per unit. Intercept: only meaningful if x = 0 makes sense.
